# 1. Setup
```{r setup, include=FALSE}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center"
)

required_packages <- c(
  "here",
  "raster",
  "sf",
  "sp",
  "knitr",
  "ggplot2"
)

missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !required_packages %in%
    rownames(installed.packages())
]

if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Folgende Pakete fehlen:\n",
    paste(
      missing_packages,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}

library(here)
library(raster)
library(sf)
library(sp)
library(knitr)

project_directory <- here::here()
data_directory <- here::here("data")
script_directory <- here::here("scripts")
results_directory <- here::here("results")
plot_directory <- here::here("results", "plots")
table_directory <- here::here("results", "tables")

dir.create(
  plot_directory,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

dir.create(
  table_directory,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

spatial_script <- here::here(
  "scripts",
  "spatial_functions.R"
)

omega_script <- here::here(
  "scripts",
  "OmegaTeval.R"
)

if (!file.exists(spatial_script)) {
  stop(
    "Datei nicht gefunden:\n",
    spatial_script
  )
}

if (!file.exists(omega_script)) {
  stop(
    "Datei nicht gefunden:\n",
    omega_script
  )
}

source(spatial_script)
source(omega_script)

if (!exists("load_spatial_data")) {
  stop(
    "load_spatial_data() wurde nicht geladen."
  )
}

if (!exists("OmegaTeval")) {
  stop(
    "OmegaTeval() wurde nicht geladen."
  )
}
```

# 2. Konfiguration

```{r configuration}

analysis_mode <- "multiple"

thobs <- 0.1
thsim <- 0.1

single_reference_path <- here::here(
  "data",
  "Sattelbach_Deposition_Area_2013.shp"
)

single_reference_field <- NULL

single_simulation_path <- here::here(
  "data",
  "releaseSattelbach_5a68fcffb6_voellmy_FlowThickness.tif"
)

single_simulation_field <- NULL

multiple_simulation_paths <- c(
  here::here(
    "data",
    "releaseSattelbach_5a68fcffb6_voellmy_FlowThickness.tif"
  ),
  here::here(
    "data",
    "releaseSattelbach_529fba6c41_herschelBulkley_FlowThickness.tif"
  ),
  here::here(
    "data",
    "releaseSattelbach_1627a228ed_bingham_FlowThickness.tif"
  ),
  here::here(
    "data",
    "releaseSattelbach_bcce094a04_coulomb_FlowThickness.tif"
  )
)

multiple_simulation_ids <- c(
  "Voellmy",
  "Herschel-Bulkley",
  "Bingham",
  "Coulomb"
)

multiple_simulation_fields <- list(
  NULL,
  NULL,
  NULL,
  NULL
)
```

# 3. Einzelanalyse

```{r single-analysis}

if (analysis_mode == "single") {
  
  if (!file.exists(single_reference_path)) {
    stop(
      "Referenzdatei wurde nicht gefunden:\n",
      single_reference_path
    )
  }
  
  if (!file.exists(single_simulation_path)) {
    stop(
      "Simulationsdatei wurde nicht gefunden:\n",
      single_simulation_path
    )
  }
  
  simulation_template <- load_spatial_data(
    path = single_simulation_path
  )
  
  depo.obs <- load_spatial_data(
    path = single_reference_path,
    template = simulation_template,
    field = single_reference_field,
    background = 0
  )
  
  depo.sim <- load_spatial_data(
    path = single_simulation_path,
    template = simulation_template,
    field = single_simulation_field,
    background = 0,
    resample_method = "bilinear"
  )
  
  raster_compatible <- raster::compareRaster(
    depo.obs,
    depo.sim,
    extent = TRUE,
    rowcol = TRUE,
    crs = TRUE,
    res = TRUE,
    orig = TRUE,
    rotation = TRUE,
    values = FALSE,
    stopiffalse = FALSE
  )
  
  if (!isTRUE(raster_compatible)) {
    stop(
      "Referenz- und Simulationsraster sind nicht kompatibel."
    )
  }
  
  OmegaResults <- OmegaTeval(
    obs = depo.obs,
    sim = depo.sim,
    thobs = thobs,
    thsim = thsim
  )
  
  depo.obs.plot <- prepare_plot_raster(
    raster_object = depo.obs,
    threshold = thobs
  )
  
  depo.sim.plot <- prepare_plot_raster(
    raster_object = depo.sim,
    threshold = thsim
  )
  
  omega_single <- data.frame(
    ID = "Simulation_1",
    alpha = as.numeric(
      OmegaResults$Omega["alpha"]
    ),
    beta = as.numeric(
      OmegaResults$Omega["beta"]
    ),
    gamma = as.numeric(
      OmegaResults$Omega["gamma"]
    ),
    omega = as.numeric(
      OmegaResults$Omega["omega"]
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  write.csv(
    omega_single,
    file = file.path(
      table_directory,
      "omega_single.csv"
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  save_raster_plot(
    raster_object = depo.obs.plot,
    filename = "01_observed.png",
    title = "Observed",
    colour = "lightblue",
    plot_directory = plot_directory
  )
  
  save_raster_plot(
    raster_object = depo.sim.plot,
    filename = "02_simulated.png",
    title = "Simulated",
    colour = "salmon",
    plot_directory = plot_directory
  )
  
  save_raster_plot(
    raster_object = OmegaResults$T,
    filename = "03_union_T.png",
    title = "T: Union",
    colour = "grey50",
    plot_directory = plot_directory
  )
  
  save_raster_plot(
    raster_object = OmegaResults$X,
    filename = "04_correct_X.png",
    title = "X: Correct",
    colour = "darkgreen",
    plot_directory = plot_directory
  )
  
  save_raster_plot(
    raster_object = OmegaResults$O,
    filename = "05_overestimation_O.png",
    title = "O: Overestimation",
    colour = "orange",
    plot_directory = plot_directory
  )
  
  save_raster_plot(
    raster_object = OmegaResults$U,
    filename = "06_underestimation_U.png",
    title = "U: Underestimation",
    colour = "purple",
    plot_directory = plot_directory
  )
  
  save_raster_overview(
    observed_raster = depo.obs.plot,
    simulated_raster = depo.sim.plot,
    omega_results = OmegaResults,
    filename = "07_all_omega_rasters.png",
    plot_directory = plot_directory
  )
}
```

# 4. Ergebnis der Einzelanalyse

```{r single-result-table, results="asis"}

if (analysis_mode == "single") {
  
  knitr::kable(
    omega_single,

}
```

# 5. Mehrere Simulationen

```{r multiple-analysis}
if (analysis_mode == "multiple") {
  
  if (!requireNamespace("ggtern", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop(
      "Für den Ternärplot muss das Paket 'ggtern' installiert sein.\n\n",
      "Installation:\n",
      "install.packages('ggtern')"
    )
  }
  
  library(ggtern)
}
if (analysis_mode == "multiple") {
  
  if (
    length(multiple_simulation_paths) !=
      length(multiple_simulation_ids)
  ) {
    stop(
      "Anzahl der Simulationspfade und IDs stimmt nicht überein."
    )
  }
  
  if (
    length(multiple_simulation_paths) !=
      length(multiple_simulation_fields)
  ) {
    stop(
      "Anzahl der Simulationspfade und Attributfelder stimmt nicht überein."
    )
  }
  
  simulation_template <- load_spatial_data(
    path = multiple_simulation_paths[1]
  )
  
  depo.obs <- load_spatial_data(
    path = single_reference_path,
    template = simulation_template,
    field = single_reference_field,
    background = 0
  )
  
  n_simulations <- length(
    multiple_simulation_paths
  )
  
  simulation_layers <- vector(
    mode = "list",
    length = n_simulations
  )
  
  for (i in seq_len(n_simulations)) {
    
    simulation_layers[[i]] <- load_spatial_data(
      path = multiple_simulation_paths[i],
      template = simulation_template,
      field = multiple_simulation_fields[[i]],
      background = 0,
      resample_method = "bilinear"
    )
    
    names(
      simulation_layers[[i]]
    ) <- multiple_simulation_ids[i]
  }
  
  depo.sim <- raster::stack(
    simulation_layers
  )
  
  dat.omega <- data.frame(
    ID = multiple_simulation_ids,
    alpha = NA_real_,
    beta = NA_real_,
    gamma = NA_real_,
    omega = NA_real_,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  for (i in seq_len(n_simulations)) {
    
    OmegaResults_i <- OmegaTeval(
      obs = depo.obs,
      sim = depo.sim[[i]],
      thobs = thobs,
      thsim = thsim
    )
    
    dat.omega[
      i,
      c(
        "alpha",
        "beta",
        "gamma",
        "omega"
      )
    ] <- as.numeric(
      OmegaResults_i$Omega[
        c(
          "alpha",
          "beta",
          "gamma",
          "omega"
        )
      ]
    )
  }
  
  write.csv(
    dat.omega,
    file = file.path(
      table_directory,
      "omega_multiple.csv"
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}
```

# 6. Ergebnisse mehrerer Simulationen

```{r multiple-result-table, results="asis"}

if (analysis_mode == "multiple") {
  
  knitr::kable(
    dat.omega,
    digits = 4,
    caption = "Omega-Ergebnisse mehrerer Simulationen"
  )
}
```
# 7. Ternärplot für mehrere Simulationen

```{r multiple-ternary-plot, results="asis"}

if (analysis_mode == "multiple") {
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # ggtern prüfen und laden
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  if (!requireNamespace("ggtern", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop(
      "Das Paket 'ggtern' ist nicht installiert.\n\n",
      "Bitte installieren Sie es mit:\n",
      "install.packages('ggtern')"
    )
  }
  
  library(ggtern)
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Prüfen, ob IDs und Simulationspfade zusammenpassen
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  if (
    length(dat.omega$ID) !=
      length(multiple_simulation_paths)
  ) {
    stop(
      "Die Anzahl der Simulationen in dat.omega und ",
      "multiple_simulation_paths stimmt nicht überein."
    )
  }
  
  if (
    length(dat.omega$ID) !=
      length(multiple_simulation_ids)
  ) {
    stop(
      "Die Anzahl der Simulationen in dat.omega und ",
      "multiple_simulation_ids stimmt nicht überein."
    )
  }
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Ergebnistabelle für den Plot vorbereiten
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  dat.ternary <- dat.omega
  
  # Vollständige Datenquelle
  dat.ternary$source_path <- multiple_simulation_paths
  
  # Nur Dateiname ohne vollständigen Pfad
  dat.ternary$source_file <- basename(
    multiple_simulation_paths
  )
  
  # Lesbare Bezeichnung für die Legende
  dat.ternary$source_label <- paste0(
    dat.ternary$ID,
    " | ",
    dat.ternary$source_file
  )
  
  # Beschriftung direkt am Punkt
  dat.ternary$point_label <- paste0(
    dat.ternary$ID,
    "\nOmega = ",
    format(
      round(
        dat.ternary$omega,
        3
      ),
      nsmall = 3
    ),
    "\n",
    dat.ternary$source_file
  )
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Polygone für alpha-, beta- und gamma-dominierte Bereiche
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  # Alpha-dominierter Bereich: alpha >= 0.5
  dat.alpha <- data.frame(
    beta = c(0.5, 0, 0),
    alpha = c(0.5, 0.5, 1),
    gamma = c(0, 0.5, 0)
  )
  
  # Beta-dominierter Bereich: beta >= 0.5
  dat.beta <- data.frame(
    beta = c(1, 0.5, 0.5),
    alpha = c(0, 0, 0.5),
    gamma = c(0, 0.5, 0)
  )
  
  # Gamma-dominierter Bereich: gamma >= 0.5
  dat.gamma <- data.frame(
    beta = c(0, 0.5, 0),
    alpha = c(0, 0, 0.5),
    gamma = c(1, 0.5, 0.5)
  )
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Linie für Omega[T] >= 0
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  dat.line <- data.frame(
    beta = c(0.5, 0),
    alpha = c(0.5, 0.5),
    gamma = c(0, 0.5)
  )
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Ternärplot erstellen
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  ternary_plot <- ggtern(
    data = dat.ternary,
    aes(
      x = beta,
      y = alpha,
      z = gamma,
      colour = source_label
    )
  ) +
    
    # Alpha-dominierter Bereich
    geom_polygon(
      data = dat.alpha,
      aes(
        x = beta,
        y = alpha,
        z = gamma
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      colour = "grey40",
      fill = "red",
      alpha = 0.10,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    
    # Beta-dominierter Bereich
    geom_polygon(
      data = dat.beta,
      aes(
        x = beta,
        y = alpha,
        z = gamma
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      colour = "grey40",
      fill = "blue",
      alpha = 0.10,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    
    # Gamma-dominierter Bereich
    geom_polygon(
      data = dat.gamma,
      aes(
        x = beta,
        y = alpha,
        z = gamma
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      colour = "grey40",
      fill = "green",
      alpha = 0.10,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    
    # Linie für Omega[T] >= 0
    geom_line(
      data = dat.line,
      aes(
        x = beta,
        y = alpha,
        z = gamma
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      colour = "black",
      linewidth = 1
    ) +
    
    # Simulationspunkte
    geom_point(
      size = 4,
      alpha = 1
    ) +
    
    # Beschriftung der Simulationspunkte
    geom_text(
      aes(
        label = point_label
      ),
      vjust = -0.8,
      size = 3,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    
    # Beschriftung des beta-dominierten Bereichs
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0.65,
      y = 0.20,
      z = 0.15,
      label = "beta >= 0.5",
      parse = TRUE,
      colour = "blue",
      size = 4
    ) +
    
    # Beschriftung des gamma-dominierten Bereichs
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0.15,
      y = 0.20,
      z = 0.65,
      label = "gamma >= 0.5",
      parse = TRUE,
      colour = "darkgreen",
      size = 4
    ) +
    
    # Beschriftung des alpha-dominierten Bereichs
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0.10,
      y = 0.80,
      z = 0.10,
      label = "alpha >= 0.5",
      parse = TRUE,
      colour = "red",
      size = 4
    ) +
    
    # Beschriftung der Omega-Linie
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0.25,
      y = 0.45,
      z = 0.25,
      label = "Omega[T] >= 0",
      parse = TRUE,
      colour = "black",
      size = 4
    ) +
    
    labs(
      title = "Omega-Komponenten mehrerer Simulationen",
      subtitle = "Dominanzbereiche und Datenquellen",
      T = "beta",
      L = "alpha",
      R = "gamma",
      colour = "Datenquelle"
    ) +
    
    theme_bw() +
    
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold"
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        size = 10
      ),
      legend.text = element_text(
        size = 8
      )
    )
  
  # Plot im R-Markdown-Dokument anzeigen
  print(ternary_plot)
}
```

}
